component.name: FileUpload
component.description: File upload input with browse button, file size validation, and clear functionality.

parts.label: hidden file input
parts.description: Native file input (visually hidden, triggered by browse button).

parts.label: display field
parts.description: Read-only text input showing selected file name and size.

parts.label: clear button
parts.description: Removes selected file (optional, shown only if file selected and clearButtonLabel provided).

parts.label: helper text
parts.description: Guidance or error message below input.

layout.direction: vertical stack (label → display field + buttons → helper text)

visualStyle.radius: inherited from Inputs and Button components

behavior.map: Provides file upload functionality with visual feedback. Browse button triggers native file picker. Selected file displays as "filename (size)" in read-only input. Size validation rejects files exceeding maxSizeInBytes. Clear button removes selection. Controlled component (value prop + onFileChange callback).
behavior.rendering: Always renders hidden input, display field, and browse button. Clear button renders if file selected and clearButtonLabel provided. Helper text renders if helperText or error present.

logic.effect: Updates display field, calls onFileChange with File object.
Shows error message, clears selection, calls onFileChange(null).
Clears file selection, resets input, calls onFileChange(null).

feedback.active: File name and size appear in display field.

states.default: No file selected, browse button enabled.
states.fileSelected: File name and size displayed, clear button visible.
states.sizeError: File rejected (too large), error message shown.

content: File size formatted as KB (< 1024 KB) or MB (>= 1024 KB).
Size error message customizable via sizeErrorMessage prop.
nesting: Contains Inputs, Button, and HelperText components.

aria.required: Optional required attribute for form validation.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to browse/clear buttons, Enter/Space to activate.

responsiveness.rules: Buttons stack vertically on narrow screens. Display field fills available width.

usageNotes: Use accept prop to restrict file types (e.g., accept="image/*,.pdf").
File size validation runs client-side (maxSizeInBytes prop).
Size error message auto-displays when file exceeds limit.
Controlled component: parent manages value via onFileChange callback.
Display field is read-only (prevents manual text input).
Clicking display field triggers file picker (same as browse button).
Clear button only appears if clearButtonLabel provided AND file selected.
File size formatted: 0 KB for empty files, rounded up to 1 KB minimum.
Helper text shown below field (normal or error state).
useId generates unique ID for aria-describedby association.
